# Highlander Building Services

> Family-operated roofing and construction company serving Western North Carolina from two offices in Franklin and Sylva. Licensed NC General Contractor, insured, and a CertainTeed ShingleMaster Credentialed Contractor. In-house crews. 24-hour response to inquiries.

Highlander Building Services, Inc. is built for the Western North Carolina mountain climate — elevation, freeze-thaw cycling, wind-driven rain, and heavy tree canopy. Roofing is the primary division (replacement, repair, metal, synthetic, storm damage, commercial). Construction is a focused secondary division (additions, renovations, exteriors, outdoor living, custom projects).

## Warranty

Roofing systems carry manufacturer material warranties whose terms vary by product line and by the certification level of the installer. As a CertainTeed ShingleMaster Credentialed Contractor, Highlander can offer CertainTeed's upgraded system warranties when the complete assembly — shingles, underlayment, starters, hip and ridge, and ventilation — is installed to specification. Highlander also provides a workmanship warranty on installed work. Specific coverage, duration, and exclusions are documented in the written proposal for each project rather than quoted as generic year counts.

Roofing
- Roof replacement

- Dimensional shingle roofing

- Commercial roofing and maintenance programs
- Gutters and drainage

Construction
- Home additions
- Interior renovations (kitchens, baths, basements)
- Exterior improvements (siding, windows, trim, fascia)
- Outdoor living (decks, porches, pergolas)
- Custom-scope construction projects

## How to request a roof assessment

1. Call 828-524-7773 during business hours, or
2. Submit the online request form at https://highlandernc.com/request-inspection

Include the property address, roof age if known, and a description of the issue. A team member responds within 24 hours to schedule an on-site assessment. Assessments include a roof and attic evaluation, photo documentation, and a written scope with pricing.
